dealSummary: Paris-based AI startup Mistral is in talks with investors including Samsung and EQT to raise several billion euros at a roughly €20 billion valuation, the Financial Times reported.
Atoms, a robotics company founded by Travis Kalanick, secured a $1.7 billion round led by Andreessen Horowitz.
Meshy, which builds foundation models for AI 3D generation, raised a $400 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation.
London-based robotics startup Humanoid raised a $152 million Series A at a $1.35 billion post-money valuation, achieving unicorn status.

Prime Movers Lab led the round, Reuters reported. San Diego-based Crystalys Therapeutics, a biopharma company developing a treatment for gout, received a $130 million Series B led by Frazier Life Sciences.
Candid Health, a San Francisco-based developer of a revenue cycle management platform for healthcare providers, raised a $120 million Series D led by Sixth Street Growth.
Venezuela-based fintech Cashea raised $100 million across two rounds: a $60 million Series B led by FinSight Ventures and a $40 million Series A led by Spice Expeditions.
leadInvestors: FinSight Ventures, a $40 million Series A led by Spice Expeditions

dealSummary: Genius AI (formerly GlossGenius), which develops an AI operations platform for service businesses, secured a $44 million Series D led by Lux Capital at a $1.15 billion valuation.
Arrakis, an AI agent deployment startup focused on industrial operations, raised a $30 million Series A led by Blossom Capital.
Assured, which uses AI agents to automate healthcare provider credentialing and enrollment, received a $19 million Series A led by Insight Partners.
Berlin-based Passionfroot, the developer of a marketplace connecting B2B creators with brands, secured a $15 million Series A led by Insight Partners.
